status: fixed before any measurement was computed; the analysis code reads its thresholds from this file

gate.a_definition: genes involved in adjacent split-in-synteny events minus genes involved in non-adjacent same-genome events, divided by 3,585,303
gate.b_definition: gold instances with >= 2 resolved members containing >= 1 adjacent-composite X gene, adjacent-event Y gene or fragment, divided by 7,096
gate.verdict_if_not: park sub-genic tokens until the Omnitrophota collection

composite.control_1: same genome, not adjacent (literal gate control)
composite.control_2: within-genome shuffle of gene positions, seeds 17, 18, 19 (reported beside)

fragment.partner_set: unique sequences in another genome with a hit where either side is covered >= 0.7
fragment.contig_edge_gene: gene within 3 nt of a contig end (start <= 3 or end >= length_nt - 2)

refutation.composite: adjacent events not above the within-genome-shuffle expectation, or adjacent Y1/Y2 co-oriented and in X-region order at about the chance rate (50 %) instead of near 100 %
refutation.fragment: fragment rate of contig-edge genes equal to interior genes and flat across genome completeness
refutation.gold: affected instances recover the same best-locus F1 as unaffected instances within caller x size strata
refutation.giant_split: few giants have >= 2 adjacent partner genes in another genome tiling non-overlapping regions
